definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of hot weather. Derived from the adjective {暑|あつ}い (hot weather). Refers specifically to atmospheric heat, not the temperature of objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暑|あつ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧だ。
{暑|あつ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time to get used to the heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連日|れんじつ}→連日：14328_renjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暑|あつ}さ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す→体調を崩す：16480_taichouwokuzusu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of people falling ill due to the consecutive days of heat is increasing.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧ (hot weather) + さ (nominalizer). Refers exclusively to atmospheric/weather heat. For the heat of objects or liquids, use {熱|あつ}さ (from ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧). For thickness, use {厚|あつ}さ (from ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暑|あつ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧: to be beaten by the heat
- {暑|あつ}さ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: measures against the heat
- ⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暑|あつ}さ: midsummer heat
- {暑|あつ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{和|やわ}らぐ→和らぐ：07896_yawaragu⟧: the heat eases

WATCH OUT:
- {暑|あつ}さ: heat of weather (this entry)
- {厚|あつ}さ: thickness
- {熱|あつ}さ: heat of an object (hot to the touch)
